sloka: ऋषेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मामाह पुरुषर्षभः ।सूत न क्वचिदेवं ते वक्तव्यं जनसन्निधौ ।। ७.५०.१५ ॥
transliteration: ṛṣestu vacanaṁ śrutvā māmāha puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।sūta na kvacidevaṁ te vaktavyaṁ janasannidhau ।। 7.50.15 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the sage's words, the best among men (Rama) said to me, "O charioteer, you should never speak thus in the presence of people."
